name: options
meaning: Opens on the meta layout. First window open creates the meta and Globals records when the tables are empty. Last window close clears meta::CurrentUserId and User::SmtpPassword and, when not hosted, returns to meta and hides toolbars and the menu bar.
settings:
OnFirstWindowOpen -> script 2 Trigger: OnFirstWindowOpen
OnLastWindowClose -> script 3 Trigger: OnLastWindowClose
minimum version 16.0
encryption type=0 (LEGEND does not decode this code)
OnOpen layout -> meta (id 1)
keychain access to save password on
require iOS passcode on
hide all toolbars on
default menu set -> [Standard FileMaker Menus] (id 1)
